"""Export the accepted game layout as a portable complete-scene material kit."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
GAME = ROOT / 'outputs/fragrance-pearl-game'
SOURCE = ROOT / 'work/fragrance-pearl/source/花香与珠光-分割2号素材包'
KIT = ROOT / 'outputs/花香与珠光-层级修正版素材包'
WORK = ROOT / 'work/fragrance-pearl/occlusion-v4'
layout = json.loads((GAME / 'data/fragrance-pearl-layout.json').read_text())
KIT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def copy(source, relative):
    target = KIT / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, target)
    return relative

def dump(relative, value):
    target = KIT / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

copy(SOURCE / 'original.png', 'original.png')
copy(GAME / layout['scene']['baseAssetKey'], 'base.png')
copy(ROOT / 'outputs/花香与珠光-交互验证.html', '试玩.html')
copy(GAME / 'data/fragrance-pearl-layout.json', 'game-layout.json')
copy(ROOT / 'outputs/贴纸排布规则.md', '说明/共享工作准则.md')
copy(WORK / 'occlusion-repair.json', '证据/本次层级修改.json')
for relative in ['all-175-occlusion-audit.md', 'all-175-occlusion-audit.json']:
    copy(WORK / 'audit' / relative, '证据/' + relative)
copy(ROOT / 'work/fragrance-pearl/validation/camera-followup/区域镜头修正说明.md', '说明/区域放大接入.md')

assets = []
for owner in layout['stickers']:
    identifier = owner['stickerId']
    file = copy(GAME / owner['assetKey'], f'stickers/{identifier}.png')
    mask = copy(SOURCE / 'masks' / f'{identifier}.png', f'masks/{identifier}.png')
    parts = []
    for index, part in enumerate(owner['renderParts']):
        part_file = copy(GAME / part['assetKey'], f'assembly/{identifier}-{index}.png')
        position = {'x': owner['position']['x'] + part['offset']['x'],
                    'y': owner['position']['y'] + part['offset']['y']}
        parts.append({'part_id': part['partId'], 'kind': 'complete', 'role': part.get('role'),
                      'file': part_file, 'origin_xy': [position['x'], position['y']],
                      'offset_xy': [part['offset']['x'], part['offset']['y']],
                      'size_wh': [part['sourceSize']['width'], part['sourceSize']['height']],
                      'pixel_size_wh': list(Image.open(GAME / part['assetKey']).size),
                      'z': part['placementOrder'], 'layer_index': part['layerIndex'],
                      'requires_asset_ids': part.get('requiresAssetIds', []),
                      'transform_with_owner': part.get('transformWithOwner', False),
                      'assembly_only': part.get('assemblyOnly', False),
                      'sha256': sha(GAME / part['assetKey'])})
    assets.append({'id': identifier, 'name_zh': owner['name'], 'category': owner['category'],
                   'region': owner['geoBlock'], 'area_level': owner['areaLevel'], 'file': file,
                   'pixel_size_wh': list(Image.open(GAME / owner['assetKey']).size),
                   'origin_xy': [owner['position']['x'], owner['position']['y']],
                   'logical_size_wh': [owner['sourceSize']['width'], owner['sourceSize']['height']],
                   'anchor_xy': [owner['anchor']['x'], owner['anchor']['y']],
                   'scale': owner['scale'], 'rotation': owner['rotation'],
                   'z': owner['layerIndex'], 'placement_order': owner['placementOrder'],
                   'assembly_step': owner['assemblyStep'], 'depends_on': owner.get('dependsOn', []),
                   'completed': True, 'intentional_edit': owner.get('intentionalEdit', False),
                   'intentional_change': owner.get('intentionalChange'),
                   'use_source_visible_overlay': False, 'original_visible_mask': mask,
                   'original_correspondence': owner['sourcePlacement'],
                   'complete_png_unchanged_in_revision4': True, 'sha256': sha(GAME / owner['assetKey']),
                   'render_parts': parts})

regions = []
for block in sorted(layout['geoBlocks'], key=lambda b: b['blockOrder']):
    bounds = block['cameraBounds']
    regions.append({'id': block['blockId'], 'name_zh': block['name'], 'block_order': block['blockOrder'],
                    'camera_view_xyxy': [bounds['x'], bounds['y'], bounds['x'] + bounds['width'], bounds['y'] + bounds['height']],
                    'required_asset_ids': block['requiredStickerIds'], 'area_counts': block['areaCounts'],
                    'stage_order': ['L1', 'L2', 'L3'], 'empty_stage_policy': 'skip',
                    'completion_rule': 'all logical owners placed and existing paste/celebration complete',
                    'next_region': block['nextBlockId']})

manifest = {'schema_version': 'complete-scene-sticker-kit/2', 'layout_revision': 4,
            'title': '花香与珠光 · 层级修正版', 'canvas_size_wh': [layout['scene']['width'], layout['scene']['height']],
            'original': 'original.png', 'base': 'base.png', 'reconstructed': 'reconstructed.png',
            'coordinate_system': 'top-left logical pixels, x right, y down; PNG texels separate',
            'logical_asset_count': 175, 'render_part_count': 180,
            'assets': assets, 'regions': regions,
            'assembly_order': [s['stickerId'] for s in sorted(layout['stickers'], key=lambda s: s['assemblyStep'])],
            'render_rule': 'sort every active render part globally by z ascending; placement time never changes paint order',
            'camera_contract': {'reference': '游戏1号区域镜头，保持游戏3其他效果',
                                'interpolation': 'smoothstep world translation and scale on one shared progress',
                                'zoom_overview_ms': 700, 'hold_ms': 450, 'zoom_next_ms': 800,
                                'final_region_total_ms': 1150, 'target_bounds': 'complete owner and render-part union',
                                'raster_policy': 'keep native separate PNG textures; no low-resolution flattened world'},
            'revision4_changes': layout['occlusionRepair'],
            'source_archive_sha256': sha(Path(layout['source']['archive'])),
            'source_files_unmodified': True, 'source_layout_sha256': sha(GAME / 'data/fragrance-pearl-layout.json')}
dump('manifest.json', manifest)

reconstruct_source = '''from pathlib import Path
import json
from PIL import Image

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
canvas = Image.open(root / manifest["base"]).convert("RGBA")
parts = [(asset, part) for asset in manifest["assets"] for part in asset["render_parts"]]
for asset, part in sorted(parts, key=lambda pair: pair[1]["z"]):
    if asset["scale"] != 1 or asset["rotation"] != 0 or asset["anchor_xy"] != [0, 0]:
        raise ValueError("Canonical reconstruction uses original owner pose; editable pose rendering is in game-layout.json.")
    image = Image.open(root / part["file"]).convert("RGBA")
    size = tuple(map(int, part["size_wh"]))
    if image.size != size:
        image = image.resize(size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    canvas.alpha_composite(image, tuple(map(int, part["origin_xy"])))
canvas.convert("RGB").save(root / manifest["reconstructed"])
print("Reconstructed 175 complete owners in 180 globally ordered parts.")
'''
(KIT / 'reconstruct.py').write_text(reconstruct_source)
exec(compile(reconstruct_source, str(KIT / 'reconstruct.py'), 'exec'), {'__file__': str(KIT / 'reconstruct.py')})
copy(KIT / 'reconstructed.png', '预览/完整组装.png')
shutil.copy2(KIT / 'reconstructed.png', ROOT / 'outputs/花香与珠光-完成预览.png')
for name in ['perfume-cabinet-revision4.png', 'held-perfume-revision4.png', 'sofa-distillery-revision4.png',
             'glass-sewing-intersection-revision4.png', 'jeweler-arms-revision4.png']:
    copy(WORK / 'audit/after-review' / name, '预览/' + name)

(KIT / '使用说明.txt').write_text('''花香与珠光 · 层级修正版素材包（版本4）

打开“试玩.html”即可离线试玩。镜头只参考游戏1号的区域放大：0.7秒退全景、0.45秒停留、0.8秒进下区；最后一区1.15秒结束。游戏3的取贴、镊子、纸张压平、庆祝效果与界面继续使用原实现。

175张完整透明贴纸在stickers目录，PNG像素为逻辑尺寸的2倍；完整单体的PNG与版本3逐字节一致。原始画风、色彩和原始ZIP保持。assembly目录是180个组装绘制部分，技术前景不增加玩家件数。

manifest.json记录每件坐标、尺寸、层级、区域、阶段、依赖与绘制子层。game-layout.json是游戏引擎使用的完整排布。按全局render_parts[].z升序绘制，不能按玩家贴放时间或区域父节点改变遮挡。纸栏和拿起效果必须使用完整stickers PNG。L050柜框及L002握瓶指尖采用当前同一PNG的互补分层，必须与所属物件共同移动、缩放、旋转、改锚点，不可留在旧位置。旧原画可见碎片只在masks目录留作对应证据，不参与绘制。

本次修复柜框与书盒、沙发与后柜、玻璃展柜与后木柜、手指与瓶身的遮挡；笔记本略下移到实际桌面内。没有重新绘画。原图original.png用于对照；base.png为此前已批准的干净底图。reconstructed.png是当前全部贴完效果；原图与补全版存在先前授权的结构修复差异，不能称逐像素还原。

运行python reconstruct.py可重复组装，需要Pillow。区域放大运动属于游戏运行逻辑，说明/区域放大接入.md描述接入方法；完整微信/Cocos接入代码在旁边“花香与珠光-手机游戏框架.zip”。本包保留浏览器试玩；微信、iOS/Android真机与Cocos GPU验收尚未进行。
''')
print(json.dumps({'kit': str(KIT), 'owners': len(assets), 'parts': sum(len(a['render_parts']) for a in assets)}, ensure_ascii=False))

"""Package the new game and its review artifacts without changing source artwork."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import zipfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
archive_path = root.parent / '花香与珠光-手机游戏框架.zip'
excluded = {'node_modules', '__pycache__', '.git', '.DS_Store'}
files = [(p, 'fragrance-pearl-game/' + str(p.relative_to(root)))
         for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()
         and not any(part in excluded for part in p.relative_to(root).parts)]
html = root.parent / '花香与珠光-交互验证.html'
if not html.is_file():
    raise FileNotFoundError('Build the project before packaging: ' + str(html))
files.append((html, html.name))
for name in ['花香与珠光-手机预览.png', '花香与珠光-6步修复预览.png', '花香与珠光-完成预览.png',
             '花香与珠光-柜内覆盖修复.png', '花香与珠光-干净底图预览.png']:
    p = root.parent / name
    if p.is_file():
        files.append((p, name))
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
    for p, name in files:
        archive.write(p, name)
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    for p, name in files:
        assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).digest() == hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest(), name
print(json.dumps({'archive': str(archive_path), 'bytes': archive_path.stat().st_size,
                  'entries': len(files), 'CRC': 'passed', 'payloadHashes': 'passed',
                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}, ensure_ascii=False))
